name: HH regime-switch 02 — VIX-extreme contrarian long confirmed by macro_regime (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM (distinct from variant 01: it reads the dislocation via realized volatility and requires the macro_regime tag to already flag a risk-off state, and it operates on a faster 4h clock to catch the intraday panic bottom rather than the daily close): a VIX extreme is the equity-vol trigger for forced crypto-beta deleveraging, but a single VIX print can be noise; requiring macro_regime to independently register a stress state filters out lone spikes that don't propagate into a genuine liquidity event. Realized-vol elevation (vol_realized above a fitted floor) confirms crypto is itself in a panic tape, so the entry buys a truly washed-out, forced-seller-dominated bar rather than a calm one where VIX rose for an idiosyncratic equity reason. The 4h clock lets the position turn over inside the ~7-day VIX-reversion window instead of holding a full daily candle. DISCONFIRMER: on vix extreme + macro_regime risk-off entries (min 25 events), forward net-of-fee return must be >0; if requiring macro_regime confirmation does not add net return or cut drawdown versus the bare VIX signal (ablation <= 0), the regime tag is cosmetic and the spec is just variant 01 with a slower entry — kill it. Also kill if the edge is confined to the 2020 crash.
catalyst: VIX extreme co-confirmed by a macro risk-off regime tag into elevated crypto realized vol
